fields.stream_offset: unsigned integer payload placement in the assembled stream
fields.payload_sha256: lowercase SHA-256 of the container payload when accepted, otherwise null
fields.payload_hex: lowercase hex of the container payload when accepted, otherwise empty string

fragment_index.duplicate_containers: byte-identical containers collapse to one index row before accounting
fragment_index.overlap: accepted payloads that overlap must agree octet-for-octet
fragment_index.assembly: the reconstructed stream begins at offset zero and ends at the unique accepted final piece

campaign_fields.rejected_fragments: complete containers assigned to the campaign but rejected

fields.stream_offset: offset of the selected record sync in the assembled stream
fields.kind: clock, reference, science, science_block, or unsupported
fields.tick_raw: recorder tick as stored on the wire, before unwrap
fields.payload_sha256: lowercase SHA-256 of the decoded logical payload
fields.payload_hex: lowercase hex of the decoded logical payload

decoded_records.include: every integrity-valid complete record, including unsupported kinds, after duplicate collapse

clock_models.unwrap: walk decoded records in assembled-stream order and add 2^24 after a backward tick transition larger than half the recorder range
clock_models.segments: consecutive clock records after unwrap define piecewise linear oscillator segments; no extrapolation
clock_models.endpoint: a tick equal to a shared segment endpoint uses the later segment

calibration.fit: unique quadratic through recovered low, mid, and high converter observations and the ledger physical references
calibration.temperature: add temperature_coefficient * (sample_temperature_milli_c - reference_temperature_milli_c) / 1000 after the quadratic
calibration.arithmetic: exact decimal or rational arithmetic; round coefficients only when serialized; evaluate observations from unrounded coefficients, then round once

observations.calibrated: decimal string with exactly four fractional digits

provenance.product_sha256: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of assembly, decoded records, clock models, calibration, records, observations, and manifest

self_consistency.clock: Applying the fitted model to an unwrapped clock tick recovers that record's UTC milliseconds exactly.
self_consistency.reference: Evaluating the unrounded calibration at a recovered reference raw count and the ledger reference temperature recovers the corresponding ledger physical value.
